help_texts.aoci_index.py:
usage: aoci_index.py [-h] [-V]
                     {init,scan,status,upsert,ack,lint,migrate-renames,verify,query,context,overview,outline,shard,restore,diff,scaffold,ensure-git-exclude,audit,export,pool,install-git-hooks,pack,prepare-sync,zoom,apply-sync,symbol,batch-pack,ci-check,refs,doctor} ...

AOCI Fast Codebase Index Manager

positional arguments:
  {init,scan,status,upsert,ack,lint,migrate-renames,verify,query,context,overview,outline,shard,restore,diff,scaffold,ensure-git-exclude,audit,export,pool,install-git-hooks,pack,prepare-sync,zoom,apply-sync,symbol,batch-pack,ci-check,refs,doctor}
    init                Initialize `.aoci/` index repository and enforce `.git/info/exclude`
    scan                Detect codebase drift and generate line-balanced batching plan
    status              Detect codebase drift and generate line-balanced batching plan
    upsert              Validate & merge FRAS entries into `aoci.code.txt` and `baseline.json`
    ack                 Re-baseline modified files whose existing FRAS entries are still accurate
                        (auto Size tier refresh)
    lint                FRAS quality checks (vague F, token budget, hub S, dangling refs, dups)
    migrate-renames     Migrate exact-content (and high-similarity moved+edited) renamed files and
                        rewrite R:/A: refs
    verify              Verify Git exclusion, entry format, and zero SHA-256 drift
    query               Filter or BM25-search `.aoci/aoci.code.txt` entries or trace impact
                        neighbors
    context             Expand architectural subgraph (targets + R: deps + upstream callers)
    overview            Print compact global digest for fast orientation
    outline             Extract static imports and top-level symbols to assist R:/A: authoring
    shard               Split `aoci.code.txt` into per-directory `.aoci/shards/<dir>.code.txt`
                        slices (auto-synced once enabled)
    restore             Zero-token restore of FRAS entries from `<git-common-dir>/aoci-cache`
                        after branch switches or worktrees
    diff                Generate architectural impact briefing (FRAS + S: traps + affected
                        callers) for Git diffs
    scaffold            Draft FRAS entry skeletons with auto-resolved R: imports and repo-wide A:
                        callers (<TODO> F:/S:)
    ensure-git-exclude  Idempotently enforce `.aoci/` in `.git/info/exclude`
    audit               Audit FRAS graph vs static imports, dependency cycles (Tarjan SCC), and
                        forbidden layer edges
    export              Export FRAS dependency graph in Mermaid, Graphviz DOT, or standalone HTML
                        format
    pool                Inspect, export, or import `.pool.sqlite3` semantic cache entries
    install-git-hooks   Install or remove idempotent local Git hooks (`post-checkout`/`post-
                        merge`/`post-rewrite` + optional `pre-commit`)
    pack                Build a task-driven, token-budgeted context pack (seeds + R:/A:
                        neighborhood + S: traps + open_next)
    prepare-sync        Collect single-pass agent sync briefing (scaffolds, outlines, bounded
                        diffs, neighbors, actions)
    zoom                Read, scaffold, or upsert symbol-level H-tier sections in
                        `.aoci/aoci.hubs.txt`
    apply-sync          Run ordered sync workflow (restore -> migrate-renames -> ack -> upsert ->
                        verify) in one pass
    symbol              Search symbols across `.aoci/aoci.hubs.txt`, outline cache, and FRAS `A:`
                        exports
    batch-pack          Assemble a self-contained subagent work-pack (scaffolds + outlines +
                        optional source) for batch N
    ci-check            CI-native architecture guard (layer rules, cycles, PR diff impact, GitHub
                        annotations & SARIF 2.1.0)
    refs                Locate cross-file symbol references and call sites pruned by the FRAS
                        dependency graph
    doctor              Zero-token mechanical self-healer (duplicates, Size tiers, dangling R:/A:
                        refs, optional static R: sync, hubs)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -V, --version         show program's version number and exit

usage: aoci_index.py scan [-h] [--root ROOT] [--batches BATCHES]
                          [--max-batch-lines MAX_BATCH_LINES] [--reset-batches] [--fast]
                          [--git-fast] [--auto-restore] [--check-only] [--fail-on-drift]
                          [--max-bytes MAX_BYTES] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

  --batches, --batch-size BATCHES
                        Split pending files into batches of up to N files per batch (`--batch-size
                        N`)
  --max-batch-lines MAX_BATCH_LINES
                        Maximum line budget per batch (default: 2500)
  --reset-batches       Rebuild `.aoci/.cache/batch_plan.json` from current pending files
  --fast                Skip disk reads when mtime & byte size match baseline
  --git-fast            Use cached Git index + `git status` incremental discovery (auto-enabled on
                        >=2000-file repos with --fast)
  --auto-restore        Automatically restore matching `(path, sha256)` entries from semantic
                        cache pool before scanning
  --check-only          Do not auto-repair `.git/info/exclude`
  --fail-on-drift       Exit with code 1 if any drift exists
  --max-bytes MAX_BYTES
  --json                Output JSON

help_texts.aoci_index.py upsert:
usage: aoci_index.py upsert [-h] [--root ROOT] [--entries-file ENTRIES_FILE]
                            [--pending-dir PENDING_DIR] [--clean-pending] [--entry ENTRY]
                            [--stdin] [--prune-only] [--no-prune] [--strict-size] [--dry-run]
                            [--drop-malformed] [--max-bytes MAX_BYTES] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target codebase root
  --entries-file ENTRIES_FILE
                        Path to a text file containing object-fras-v2 lines
  --pending-dir PENDING_DIR
                        Directory containing `*.txt` subagent batch entry files to validate and
                        merge atomically
  --clean-pending       Remove consumed `*.txt` files in `--pending-dir` after a successful non-
                        dry-run merge
  --entry ENTRY         Single object-fras-v2 line (repeatable)
  --stdin               Read object-fras-v2 lines from stdin
  --prune-only          Only prune deleted/ignored files from index
  --no-prune            Do not automatically prune deleted files
  --strict-size         Fail instead of auto-fixing stale Size tier
  --dry-run             Validate entries without writing to disk
  --drop-malformed      Allow the rewrite to delete pre-existing malformed lines in aoci.code.txt
  --max-bytes MAX_BYTES
  --json                Output JSON

options:

  --impl-only           Acknowledge only modified files whose interface signature hash is
                        unchanged (requires --reviewed unless --dry-run)
  --reviewed            Confirm every file matched by --all-modified was read and its FRAS entry
                        verified accurate
  --dry-run             Preview without writing
  --max-bytes MAX_BYTES
  --json                Output JSON

help_texts.aoci_index.py query:
usage: aoci_index.py query [-h] [--root ROOT] [--layer LAYER] [--domain DOMAIN]
                           [--min-importance MIN_IMPORTANCE] [--path PATH] [--keyword KEYWORD]
                           [--search SEARCH] [--top TOP] [--impact IMPACT] [--tests-for TESTS_FOR]
                           [--live-test-imports] [--depth DEPTH] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target codebase root
  --layer LAYER         Filter by Layer code(s), e.g. `M` or `E,A,M`
  --domain DOMAIN       Filter by Domain code(s), e.g. `O` or `A,O`
  --min-importance MIN_IMPORTANCE
                        Filter entries with Importance >= N
  --path PATH           Glob pattern on relative path (e.g. `src/auth/*`)
  --keyword KEYWORD     Case-insensitive exact substring filter
  --search SEARCH       Ranked multi-term BM25 + Importance search across path/symbols/F/R/A/S
  --top TOP             Maximum entries to return (default: 20 with --search; 0 = unlimited)
  --impact IMPACT       Target file plus every entry that depends on it (via R: or A: callers)
  --tests-for TESTS_FOR
                        Target file to find impacted T-layer test files (FRAS + outline + naming)
  --live-test-imports   Read uncached T-layer test imports in memory when outline_cache.json is
                        missing/stale
  --depth DEPTH         Transitive hops (default: 1 for --impact, 3 for --tests-for)
  --json                Output JSON

                           [--co-change-commits CO_CHANGE_COMMITS]

                        Minimum co-change commit count (default: 3)
  --min-co-confidence MIN_CO_CONFIDENCE
                        Minimum co-change confidence in [0,1] (default: 0.6)
  --exclude-tests       Exclude T-layer test files from --co-change pairs
  --strict              Exit 1 when any missing static dep, cycle, or layer violation exists
  --max-bytes MAX_BYTES
  --json                Output JSON

                        Output format (default: mermaid)
  --level {file,dir,domain}
                        Aggregation level (default: file)
  --group-by {domain,dir,layer,none}
                        Subgraph grouping for file level
  --direction {LR,TD,TB}
                        Graph layout direction (default: LR)
  --layer LAYER         Filter nodes by Layer code(s)
  --domain DOMAIN       Filter nodes by Domain code(s)
  --min-importance MIN_IMPORTANCE
                        Filter nodes with Importance >= N
  --path PATH           Glob filter on relative file paths
  --focus FOCUS         Center subgraph on a target file and its neighbors
  --depth DEPTH         Neighborhood hops around `--focus` (default: 1)
  --diff                Highlight working-tree changed nodes and affected 1-hop callers
  --diff-rev DIFF_REV   Highlight changed nodes and affected callers against Git revision (e.g.
                        `origin/main`)
  --output OUTPUT       Optional output file path relative to `--root`
  --json                Output JSON

help_texts.aoci_index.py apply-sync:
usage: aoci_index.py apply-sync [-h] [--root ROOT] [--restore] [--allow-sha-fallback]
                                [--migrate-renames] [--exact-only] [--no-rewrite-refs]
                                [--ack-path ACK_PATH] [--ack-impl-only] [--reviewed]
                                [--entry ENTRY] [--entries-file ENTRIES_FILE]
                                [--pending-dir PENDING_DIR] [--clean-pending] [--prune-only]
                                [--no-prune] [--strict-size] [--drop-malformed] [--no-verify]
                                [--full-verify] [--max-bytes MAX_BYTES] [--dry-run] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target codebase root
  --restore             Run semantic pool restore (`--no-prune`) first
  --allow-sha-fallback  Pass `--allow-sha-fallback` to `restore`
  --migrate-renames     Migrate exact and similar renames
  --exact-only          Pass `--exact-only` to `migrate-renames`
  --no-rewrite-refs     Pass `--no-rewrite-refs` to `migrate-renames`
  --ack-path ACK_PATH   Path to acknowledge via `ack` (repeatable; requires --reviewed)
  --ack-impl-only       Acknowledge `impl_only` modified files (requires --reviewed)
  --reviewed            Confirm acknowledged files were read and verified
  --entry ENTRY         object-fras-v2 line to merge in `upsert` (repeatable)
  --entries-file ENTRIES_FILE
                        File containing object-fras-v2 lines to merge in `upsert`
  --pending-dir PENDING_DIR
                        Directory of `*.txt` batch files to merge in `upsert`
  --clean-pending       Remove consumed `*.txt` batch files after `upsert`
  --prune-only          Pass `--prune-only` to `upsert`
  --no-prune            Pass `--no-prune` to `upsert`
  --strict-size         Pass `--strict-size` to `upsert`
  --drop-malformed      Allow dropping pre-existing malformed lines
  --no-verify           Skip trailing `verify` check
  --full-verify         Run full `verify` instead of `verify --fast`
  --max-bytes MAX_BYTES
                        Override max source file size in bytes across stages
  --dry-run             Preview mutating stages without writing to disk
  --json                Output JSON

help_texts.aoci_index.py ci-check:
usage: aoci_index.py ci-check [-h] [--root ROOT] [--format {text,json,github,sarif,markdown}]
                              [--base-rev BASE_REV] [--pool-bundle POOL_BUNDLE] [--forbid FORBID]
                              [--no-default-rules] [--no-static] [--no-cycles] [--no-layers]
                              [--check-drift] [--exclude-tests] [--sarif-output SARIF_OUTPUT]
                              [--markdown-output MARKDOWN_OUTPUT] [--output OUTPUT] [--strict]
                              [--max-bytes MAX_BYTES] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target codebase root
  --format {text,json,github,sarif,markdown}
                        Report output format (default: text)
  --base-rev BASE_REV   Base Git revision (e.g. `origin/main`) for PR diff impact & test
                        derivation
  --pool-bundle POOL_BUNDLE
                        Optional exported semantic pool bundle (`.json` or `.json.gz`) for zero-
                        index CI
  --forbid FORBID       Extra layer redlines (e.g. `D!->E,U; P!->E`)
  --no-default-rules    Disable built-in layer redline defaults
  --no-static           Skip static import vs FRAS cross-check
  --no-cycles           Skip dependency cycle detection
  --no-layers           Skip layer redline validation
  --check-drift         Also report unsynced `.aoci/` drift when `.aoci/` exists
  --exclude-tests       Exclude T-layer test files from layer/cycle checks
  --sarif-output SARIF_OUTPUT
                        Optional file path to write SARIF 2.1.0 output alongside stdout
  --markdown-output MARKDOWN_OUTPUT
                        Optional file path to write PR Markdown summary alongside stdout
  --output OUTPUT       Optional file path to write formatted report
  --strict              Exit with code 1 when any architectural finding exists
  --max-bytes MAX_BYTES
  --json                Shortcut for `--format json`
